physical.mounting-hardware: Hex bolt x3, nut x3, washer x6 and split washer x3 (instruction sheet)

configs.description: The manager as APC ships AR8615, its door fitted.
configs.name: base

configs.description: The same manager with its door taken off, the finger columns and the channel open to lay a cable in. The door comes with the manager, so this is an illustration and not a device type.
configs.name: doors-off

gaps.note: the door "opens to left or right" on hinge pins and lifts off; the instruction sheet shows a quarter-turn latch and the door swinging off the finger tips either way, but no view dimensions a hinge. The door is drawn as one fitted plate that is either on or off.
gaps.wanted: a drawing or a close render of the door's hinge pins and latch

gaps.note: the data sheet advertises "multiple internal cable tie-off locations". The instruction sheet draws the slots and punches in the back plate that they are, but dimensions none, and the format has no place to state a tie point on a duct (#1009 states them only on the FS tray). They are not drawn or stated.
gaps.wanted: the back plate's slots dimensioned, and a place in the format for a duct's tie points

gaps.note: the instruction sheet shows an optional grounding and bonding point, a tab with a hole bent up at the foot of the back plate, "Hardware and cable not provided". No thread or hole size is stated, and a grounding point in the format is a stud or screw with a thread, so none is stated.
gaps.wanted: the size of the hole and the screw it takes

gaps.note: APC states "high capacity" and no figure on the data sheet, the instruction sheet or the brochure, so none is recorded and none is estimated.
gaps.wanted: a capacity figure and the cable it is stated for

gaps.note: the instruction sheet's isometric figure draws each finger as a smooth tongue with a rolled root. It is built as an arm 12 across and a hooked tip 22 across, 31 high, 296 long; the size, the length and the count (44, counted at constant pitch) are read off a figure that is not dimensioned.
gaps.wanted: a section through a finger and the back plate

gaps.note: where the first finger stands against the rack's units is not stated: the fingers are centred on the 2134 mm height, and which hole of the upright each bolt takes is not dimensioned, so whether they sit on the rack's units is not known.
gaps.wanted: the heights of the three bolt holes against the rack's first unit

gaps.note: the single-sided part has a back plate that takes the AR8652 spacer bracket (a PDU bracket) and the accessory brackets, sold separately; the instruction sheet draws them but they are other parts and are not drawn.
gaps.wanted: the accessory parts, if they are modelled

gaps.note: the door has an oval opening near its top in the instruction sheet's figure; it is not drawn.
how far the manager stands from the upright when it is bolted on is not dimensioned; the part is drawn alone.
gaps.wanted: a dimensioned drawing of the manager fitted to an upright
no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the colour, the plastic fingers, the hardware (the instruction sheet's three hex bolts, nuts and washers, split washers), the provided doors and installation guide, UL Listed and EU RoHS compliant are the data sheet and the instruction sheet.

bottom.note: estimated - the top view again: the two ends of the manager are alike.

capacity.note: datasheet - the AR8615 data sheet and the brochure state no cable capacity, only "high capacity". None is estimated here (see `gaps`).

chassis.note: datasheet - 152 x 2134 x 360, door fitted: "Width 6.0 in (152 mm)", "Height 84.02 in (2134 mm)", "Depth 14.2 in (360 mm)".

color.note: estimated - "Color: Black". Every image APC publishes of the part is a render; it is drawn black, the door a shade lighter than the back plate.

depth.note: estimated - the 360 is the data sheet's. It is drawn as a 60 back plate zone and a 300 well: the double-sided AR8625 is 26.0 in (660 mm), two wells and one back plate zone, and the two figures solve to 300 and 60. No view sections the part.

front.note: estimated - the working face with the door fitted: the door, and under it the back plate with its 44 fingers a side in four sections of 11, centred on the height. The `duct` guide is the channel between the two finger columns, run down the height: the width less the 6 mm margin and 22 mm finger on each side, ESTIMATED from the instruction sheet's figure.

guides.note: estimated - the duct is the channel between the two finger columns, run down the height (`run: y`). The finger pitch is the rack unit, 44.45, as the data sheet's "1U increments"; the gap is the pitch less the 31 mm finger, 13.45, ESTIMATED from the finger's drawn thickness.

left.note: estimated - no side view of the manager without its door is dimensioned: the back plate, and the finger zone along it, built from the plan and the finger columns' extent.

method.note: FIGURES FROM THE MAKER'S OWN DOCUMENTS, read as data: the AR8615 product data sheet (fetched from se.com), the instruction sheet 990-4576A-001 (1/2016), which covers all six parts, and the brochure "Enclosure and Rack Systems, Cable Management". THE FIGURES THE DATA SHEET PRINTS (height, width, depth, weight) ARE `datasheet`; EVERYTHING READ OFF THE INSTRUCTION SHEET'S FIGURES (the fingers' count and size, the door, the split of the depth) IS ESTIMATED and said so in the part that carries it. APC publishes no drawing or CAD for these parts: the product page lists the instruction sheet, the brochure and environmental declarations only. No drawing or photograph is copied.

mount.note: datasheet - `rack-side`: "Mounting Mode: Not rack-mountable" on the data sheet, and the instruction sheet "Vertical Cable Manager Installation for Open Frame Racks" (990-4576A-001) bolts it to the side of the rack's upright with three hex bolts, nuts and washers. It occupies no rack unit. `ru: 44` is the rack height it runs beside: the data sheet's 84.02 in (2134 mm) is the height of the whole part, top and bottom brackets included, and the fingers are 44 rack units; 44 is the height of the AR203A and one short of the AR201's 45, so one figure places it beside either (lint L154 judges a part by `ru`). Which side of the rack is a lab placement to say (docs/vertical-cable-managers-design.md).

rear.note: estimated - the back of the single-sided part is its back plate, the face that stands against the rack's upright. The instruction sheet draws it slotted and punched; no document dimensions the slots, so it is drawn plain (see `gaps`).

right.note: estimated - the left view turned round.

shell.note: estimated - A HOLLOW CHANNEL, NOT A BOX. The body is a sheet body and its six views are elevations; the solid is what its parts build: the back plate as a well 300 deep, the 88 fingers standing off its floor and the door over their tips, which pulls off and opens the channel.

thickness.note: estimated - no APC document states a gauge. 1.5 is a sheet of this kind; the parts carry their own thicknesses.

top.note: estimated - the plan, rear at y=0: the back plate zone and the two finger columns, from the finger length above.

weight.note: datasheet - "Net Weight 60.0 lb(US) (27.2 kg)"; packed 33.1 kg.
